subject: general
question: **Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word**: He could not **lead **the team under pressure.

options.text: They used lead pipes in old construction.
He tried to lead the meeting professionally.
She leads the choir every Sunday.
He wrote a report on leadership styles.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "They used lead pipes in old construction."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"lead"** (in the question) is a verb that means to guide or direct a group, organization, or activity. (नेतृत्व करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She was chosen to lead the project because of her excellent management skills.
 
 
• The word **"lead"** (in Option 1) is a noun that refers to a type of metal, commonly used in construction and plumbing in the past. (सीसा)
 
 
• **Example:** The pipes in old houses were often made of lead, which is now known to be hazardous to health.
 
 
• Both words are spelled the same but have different meanings and pronunciations, making them homonyms.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** He tried to lead the meeting professionally. (नेतृत्व करना): Refers to the same meaning as the highlighted word in the question.
 
 
• **Example:** She will lead the discussion on climate change at the conference.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** She leads the choir every Sunday. (नेतृत्व करना): This also refers to guiding or directing, similar to the highlighted word.
 
 
• **Example:** He leads the team with great energy and enthusiasm.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** He wrote a report on leadership styles. (नेतृत्व): Refers to the concept or styles of leading, not a homonym of the word "lead."
 
 
• **Example:** Leadership styles vary greatly among different organizations.
 
 

5e:Ta17,

The correct answer is **Option 1**.<
